rationale: With only 22 minutes to close, DPZ has already recovered significantly from its gap-down open ($287 to $299), sitting at 71% of today's range with price stalling near VWAP and the 9-EMA — momentum is indeterminate. The negative earnings catalyst (weak same-store sales, reduced guidance) has already been largely priced into the gap, making a directional edge unclear, and the wide bid-ask spread (16.7 bps) combined with end-of-session liquidation risk makes the risk/reward unattractive for a new position.
